tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Read-only. Lists every industry and sub-vertical ExitValue.ai tracks, with their ids and display names, and flags which sub-verticals have published multiples (has_published_multiples). Takes no input. Use it first when you are unsure of an id; the other tools accept these ids or plain-English names

tools.name: get_valuation_multiples
tools.description: Read-only. Answers 'what multiple does a business in industry X sell for?' for ONE industry. tools.name: compare_industries
tools.description: Read-only. Puts 2-6 industries side by side for one metric: median multiple, middle 50% (25th-75th percentile) and deal count n per industry, using the same data, name matching and thresholds as get_valuation_multiples. tools.name: get_multiples_trend
tools.description: Read-only. Year-by-year history for ONE sub-vertical: for each deal year 2018-2026, the median EV/EBITDA and/or EV/Revenue multiple with middle 50% (25th-75th percentile), deal count n and median deal value. Only years with at least 10 disclosed deals for a metric are shown; missing years are listed
